messages:
natalie_p: quick postmortem follow-up 026-04 streaming reliability. we keep seeing short/partial chunks and client reconnect storms in production. need three owners: signal/detection, runtime mitigations, and SDK/client patterns. link to postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/streaming-apr-2026. please volunteer with short deliverables and dates.

infra-bot: incident logged STREAM-APR-26-partial-reconnects (sev3).

mira_eng: i'll own detection + console. plan: add metric stream.partial_likely (by region/model), emit trace tag "partial_probe=1" for suspected partials (first-chunk <25 bytes + close <150ms), and create a compact alert card with top tokens and recent traces. ETA: metrics+alert by 2490002400, dashboard by 2490003600.

todd_sre: i'll take runtime mitigations. quick runway: add a configurable drain_window_ms (default 2s), implement noisy-token cooldown (quarantine token for 60s after threshold), and surface reconnect_attempts_per_session metric. will gate behind feature flags and add an auto-revert if canary p95 > baseline*1.2. ETA proposal by 2490001800, PR+canary by 2490004200.

zara_sdk: i'll own SDK guidance and telemetry. recommendation: default client backoff base=250ms max=5s max_retries=5, add client knob maxConcurrentStreamsPerToken=6, and emit telemetry when SDK throttles: event client.auto_throttle=true. will publish migration note and example. ETA SDK PR + docs by 2490004600.

natalie_p: thanks. immediate reversible mitigations we can flip within hours: (A) lower maxConcurrentStreamsPerToken to 6, (B) enable low-sensitivity partial alert, (C) temporarily lower reconnect_rate_limit to 10/s per IP for 1hr. who can flip A+C?

todd_sre: i can flip C now and monitor 30m; can flip A as well. will tag rollback criteria.

infra-bot: feature-toggle applied: reconnect_rate_limit=10/s by todd_sre (staging->prod).

mira_eng: detection detail: using trace tag partial_probe=1 avoids client changes and keeps metric cheap. will also add 1% sampled raw chunk capture for triage.

zara_sdk: SDK behavior: if telemetry reports partial_probe >=3 for a token in 10m, SDK reduces concurrency by 50% for that token and backs off 2s. opt-out via client.enableAutoThrottle=false. code snippet for notes: ```js
client.configure({ maxConcurrentStreamsPerToken: 6, enableAutoThrottle: true });
```

todd_sre: server config draft: """
stream:
  drain_window_ms: 2000
  noisy_token_quarantine_s: 60
  max_streams_per_token: 6
"""

mira_eng: tests: new streaming-e2e scenario injecting tiny first-chunks + abrupt close; assert partial_probe trace and metric increments. add a tiny repro harness for SRE.

natalie_p: rollback gates: auto-revert flags if canary p95 increases >20% for 10m OR 5xx rate increases >8% for 15m. annotate flags with playbook link and on-call.

todd_sre: adding automated revert and will post canary dashboard link here.

zara_sdk: creating tracker STREAM-TKT-9001 with subtasks and linking this thread. will include migration note in SDK changelog.

mira_eng: propose 15m triage daily for rollout week, then weekly until stable.

natalie_p: concise action list:
- detection & dashboard: owner @mira_eng, deliverable: metric+trace+sampled-capture+alert+dashboard, due 2490003600
- runtime mitigations: owner @todd_sre, deliverable: drain_window+quarantine+canary+auto-revert, due 2490004200
- SDK guidance: owner @zara_sdk, deliverable: SDK PR+docs+telemetry, due 2490004600

infra-bot: calendar event created: Streaming Reliability Triage (recurring Tue 9:30am PT) by natalie_p.

todd_sre: will post short status pings here after flag flips or canary completion. keep updates concise. thanks. :white_check_mark:
